site: Example VRX bench (not a device fact)
notes: Example only. The pinned clone states no numeric range or unit for the Float64 thruster and joint-position commands, so the driver declares them operator_required. An operator must replace these example bounds with the deployment envelope in site-limits.json; this file does not make the simulation controllable or safe, and it does not supply the missing acknowledged stop.
